tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.17
§ Eliadah or Eliada = "God knows"
1) a son of David
2) a Benjamite warrior chief
3) an Aramean, the father of an enemy of Solomon

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader
strongs_1890.derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H3045 (יָדַע); God (is) knowing;
